segmente.text: This is the dark psychology behind ads that convert.
Humans literally catch emotions from others.
When your friends are happy, excited, or relieved, your brain mirrors that feeling.
When you see an ad, the same happens.
If you see someone feeling happy to drink a Coke,
your brain will mirror this association and emotional reaction too.
This works even better if the emotion and situation is authentic.
When the emotion feels raw and real, it spreads even faster.
So if you want to have more happy customers, sell the feeling first and the product second.
Because people buy the emotion they want to feel subconsciously.
